plugin.name: Mega Nav
menu.label: Navigation
editor.title: Navigation
editor.empty: No navigation yet — create one, or import from strapi-plugin-navigation in Settings.
editor.select-item: Select an item to edit it.
editor.conflict-body: This navigation changed since you loaded it. Reload to take their version (your changes are lost), or overwrite with yours.
editor.copy-warning: Internal links carry over automatically; titles arrive untranslated.
tree.drag: Move (space to lift, arrows to move)
panel.title: Title
panel.presentation-hint: How this menu's panel is laid out
panel.link-expected: Items at this level are links in the “{layout}” layout.
panel.unused-warning: Filled but not used by the “{layout}” layout at this level.
link.none-hint: A heading that structures the menu — no target.
link.path-hint: Hand-typed internal path — prefer an internal link; these are flagged by the health check.
link.query-hint: Optional query string appended to the resolved URL (e.g. family=Manutention)
picker.draft-warn: draft, invisible on the site until published
picker.broken: This entry no longer exists — the item will render as a heading.
preview.label: Schematic preview
preview.degrades: This menu will render as “simple”: “{layout}” needs groups with children at level 2.
preview.empty: Add children to this menu item to see the panel
issues.title: Problems ({count})
issue.will-degrade: “{title}” will render as “simple” — “{layout}” needs level-2 groups.
issue.link-expected: “{title}” should be a link at this level.
issue.broken-ref: “{title}”: its internal link target no longer exists.
settings.fields.title: Item fields
settings.fields.subtitle: The fields available on menu items. Changes apply on save — no restart.
settings.fields.name: Name
settings.fields.name-hint: Key in the item data — locked after creation.
settings.fields.label: Label
settings.fields.levels-hint: Depths (1-based) where the field applies, comma-separated. Empty = every level.
settings.fields.disabled-toggle: Disabled (hidden from the editor, values kept)
settings.fields.delete-body: Disabling hides the field from the editor but keeps every stored value. Purging removes the field AND strips its values from all navigations — this cannot be undone.
settings.fields.purge-hint: To purge, type the field name: {name}
settings.layouts.title: Layouts
settings.layouts.subtitle: Each layout describes its levels, the fields each level uses, and its preview template. Edited as JSON in v1.
settings.layouts.reset-body: Every customization is discarded and the built-in layout definitions are restored.
settings.sources.title: Internal link sources
settings.sources.subtitle: Configured in config/plugins.ts (mega-nav → sources) — URL patterns are tied to the site's routes, so they live in code.
settings.sources.empty: No source configured. Add sources: [{ uid, titleField, pattern }] to the plugin config to enable internal links.
settings.sources.health-hint: Lists broken internal links, missing media, hand-typed path escape hatches and orphan field keys across every navigation draft.
settings.sources.health-ok: No issue found — every reference resolves.
migration.title: Import from strapi-plugin-navigation
migration.subtitle: Reads the old plugin's tables directly — both plugins can stay installed during the transition.
migration.detect-error: The scan failed — check the server logs.
migration.not-found: No strapi-plugin-navigation tables in this database — nothing to migrate.
migration.overwrite-hint: Off: a navigation whose slug already exists here is skipped and reported. On: it is replaced.
migration.links-note: Relative legacy links are matched against the configured sources and become true internal links; the rest is kept as raw paths and reported.
migration.simulate-hint: Runs the whole pipeline — reads, link normalization, media checks, locale pairing — without writing anything.
migration.run-ready: The import replays exactly what the simulation reported.
migration.run-gated: Run a simulation first — the import stays locked until then.
migration.confirm-overwrite: At least one existing navigation will be REPLACED by the import.
migration.confirm-skip: At least one navigation already exists and will be skipped (overwrite is off).
migration.uninstall-reminder: Verify the result, point the site to this plugin's render endpoint, then uninstall strapi-plugin-navigation.
